description: Opus BB unit B16: `choicelock`'s `onDisableMove` (endTurn) removes the lock when the holder no longer has the locked move (`!pokemon.hasMove(this.effectState.move)`). In the setup turn faster Dragapult uses Dragon Dance; Choice Scarf Oricorio dances it (Dancer: an external move whose ModifyMove locks Oricorio into Dragon Dance, which it does not know), then its own Calm Mind fails to the lock. At the end of the turn the lock goes, so Oricorio can now use Calm Mind.
